slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are all 20 customers required to be served (i.e., every customer must be assigned to exactly one route), or is it acceptable to leave some customers unserved?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether every customer must be assigned to exactly one route, which covers the single-vehicle-per-customer requirement.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should each truck that is used start at the depot and return to the depot after its last customer, or is it acceptable for a truck to end its route at the last customer served?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot or can end at the last customer, directly covering the depot return requirement.
